name: Skills Lab: nav section, empty Skills page, Add skill modal tabs, new agents' Skills tab
description: Loads /skills and confirms the SKILLS LAB sidebar section and the empty detail pane (the seed ships no skills), opens the Add skill modal from the single Add Skill button and confirms its three tabs (Create with the directive hint under Description and the markdown body field, From file with the drop zone, Import from URL with the URL field) without saving, then confirms the two seeded agents Test Quality Reviewer and API Contract Reviewer exist and that an agent editor has a Skills tab. Read-only (no skill is created, no model call). See e2e/docs/specs/skills.md.

steps.label: load the Skills page
skills route reached
skills fetch settles
the sidebar has the Skills Lab section
nothing is selected: the detail pane prompts to pick a skill
Add Skill is one button: it opens the Add skill modal, no menu
the modal has the Import from URL tab
still on /skills (no separate create route)
Create is the default tab: the description field tells the author to write a directive
the Create tab has the markdown body field
switch to the From file tab (exact: the empty state behind the modal has an 'Import from file' button)
the From file tab shows the drop zone
switch to the Import from URL tab
the URL tab explains the URL is fetched server-side and saved disabled
load the agents list
agents fetch settles
the seeded Test Quality Reviewer exists
the seeded API Contract Reviewer exists
open the Test Quality Reviewer editor
agent editor reached on the Config tab
the editor has rendered (the URL changes before the agent loads)
switch to the agent's Skills tab (a button; the sidebar entry is a link)
the Skills tab is in the URL
the Skills tab explains that order is prompt order
